Thanks Lina — received. Two quick clarifications before we kick the micro-deposit test:

1) Can you confirm the exact account holder legal/legal entity as it should appear on remittance? The bank letter lists "GreenWave Supplies LLC" but our PO records show "GreenWave, Inc." — want to avoid failing the enrollment check.
2) If you have a direct AP inbox for remittance advices, please share that address (we usually include it in the payment note).

Marissa, looping you in — once Lina confirms we can schedule the micro-deposit; finance will post a 2x micro-deposit test (we typically use a pair of small amounts under $0.50). After Lina confirms amounts, AP will accept the bank and then we schedule first remit for the next payment run.

Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
